title: Umanari 1 Furlong Theater
overview:
The Umanari world, where raising horses is fun!

A thrilling drama woven by thoroughbreds!

- Simulates every aspect of horse racing in detail, including full training menus and foal breeding theory.
- 80 active jockeys and 1,050 real famous horses appear. You can enter races from domestic events to overseas G1 races.
- Plenty of lines that capture the horses' feelings. Communicate by talking with your horses.
- A unique training system that demands training menus matched to each horse's personality, condition, and mood.
- As an owner-breeder, you can produce the strongest thoroughbred through breeding as you please.
- Race scenes feature real-time voice commentary by a Radio Tanpa announcer.
- Includes the "Umanari Cup," where you can freely pick horses raised by you and your friends, or legendary horses of the past, and race them against each other.

育てて楽しい馬なりワールド!

サラブレッドが織りなす白熱のドラマ!

■本格メニューの調教、仔馬生産理論など競馬のすべてを緻密にシミュレーション。
■現役騎手80名、実名馬1,050頭が登場。国内から海外G1レースまでも出走可能。
■馬たちの心情を深くついたセリフを多数用意。馬と会話でコミュニケーション。
■馬の性格や体調、気分に合わせた調教メニューが要求される独自の調教システム。
■オーナーブリーダーとして、思いのままの交配で最強のサラブレッドが生産可能。
■レースシーンにラジオたんぱアナウンサーによるリアルタイムの音声実況を導入。
■自分や友だちの育てた馬、歴代の名馬を自由に選んで対戦できる『馬なりカップ』付。
